body:
> I was thinking of that, but didn't want to bloat the PR. Number should indeed be allowed too, even though it gets coerced to a string. Today it already works as `animal.cats.1.name`, but that's not very discoverable.

Ah right. My bad. Not `animal.cats[1].name` but `animal.cats.1.name`.

What I wanted to ask you was,

```
function getPropertyByPath(
  const parts = path.split('.');
  object: object | undefined,
  path: string | string[]
)
```

What if the type of `path` is `string | Array<string | number>`. Does it make sense?
